transcript.text: I need to flag something important for the rollout plan. This morning I completed a compatibility review for an unrelated mobile release and discovered that Android versions below 8.5 emit a legacy tombstone format that the new sync engine cannot reconcile. This means the approved first-rollout audience should include iOS and Android 8.5 or newer only — Android versions below 8.5 must be excluded. I haven't updated the rollout document yet because the compatibility report was only completed this morning, but this needs to be reflected in the rollout plan before Wednesday.
